findings: learner.overview.text: Add a brief, qualified explanation of the proposed whole-graph borrowing behind 其 being used for 期: the two spoken words were thought to sound similar, though the basket’s original name is not established. The entry explains this borrowing in history but omits it from the first-reading overview, where the connection to the present meaning is needed (X-19d01d81c754a7a17098, X-ef8e176d1f8708c44701).
